priorMisreadCorrection: The v3 audit (this package's own prior work) incorrectly found the S-side horizontal ray's arrowhead pointing outward (away from the magnet). On a zoomed pixel-level re-inspection (cropping a tight region around each horizontal ray's arrowhead independently, prompted by a Product Owner correction), the S-side arrowhead in fact points RIGHTWARD -- toward the magnet, i.e. into S -- exactly as it should for a field line entering S. The N-side arrowhead points rightward/outward, away from the magnet, correctly exiting N. Both are directionally correct; v3's field-line topology and direction were technically correct all along. This was a genuine visual-reading error in the prior audit, not a defect in the image -- corrected here after independent re-verification, not merely asserted on the Product Owner's authority.
